svg.title: Datasentinel PostgreSQL workload dashboard: animated walkthrough
svg.desc: Simulated data. The dashboard ranks five PostgreSQL instances by Average Active Sessions. The busiest row is expanded to show its top queries and wait breakdown, and a question is answered in the Ask Claude pane. Its top query is then opened in the Query detail sub-tab, down to its execution plan and the table it reads, and Claude is asked which index would avoid the sequential scan. Finally the Overview sub-tab shows the activity of the instance over the time window, and the Real-time sub-tab its live sessions, host metrics and a blocking chain.
